plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction rejects letter quantity

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction with the default reverse-auction ranking configuration.
Provide the required event title so the invalid quantity is the only tested invalid input.
Apply the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the requested product and enter the invalid letters in its quantity field.
Assert that the numeric quantity rejects "abc" and reports a quantity validation error.
